0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons with this game, with the Grizzlies hosting the Utah Jazz. Memphis's Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision, while Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps), and Trey Alexander (knee), all listed as out. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 147-101 Grizzlies loss in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026.
